name: Lee Sin
title: The Blind Monk

passive.name: Flurry

description.normalized: Lee Sin's Abilities grant him 40% Attack Speed for 2 attacks within 3 seconds. The first attack restores 20 energy and the second restores half of that amount.

passive.rawParsedText: Lee Sin's Abilities grant him 40% Attack Speed for 2 attacks within 3 seconds. The first attack restores 20 energy and the second restores half of that amount.

q.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike

description.normalized: Sonic Wave: Fires an energy wave that deals 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+90% AD) physical damage to enemies and reveals them. Hitting an enemy allows Resonating Strike to be cast within 3 seconds. Resonating Strike: Dash to enemy marked by Sonic Wave, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 / 160 to 110 / 180 / 250 / 360 (+90% to +200% AD) physical damage based on its missing Health.

effects.note: Formula kept in rawParsedText; structured fields are partial.

w.name: Safeguard / Iron Will

description.normalized: Safeguard: Dashes to target location. If an enemy is nearby on arrival, Lee Sin shield himself for 100 / 160 / 220 / 280 (+100% AP) for 2 seconds. Allows Iron Will to be cast within 3 seconds. Safeguard's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds with each attack. Iron Will: Empowers next two attacks to deal an additional 26 / 39 / 52 / 65 (+40% AP) magic damage and gain 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% Omnivamp.

Safeguard's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds with each attack.

Iron Will: Empowers next two attacks to deal an additional 26 / 39 / 52 / 65 (+40% AP) magic damage and gain 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% Omnivamp.

e.name: Tempest / Cripple

description.normalized: Tempest: Deals 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 (+90% AD) magic damage, to nearby enemies and reveals them for 3 seconds. Hitting an enemy allows Cripple to be cast within 3 seconds. Cripple: Slows enemies hit by Tempest by 30% / 40% / 50% / 60%, decaying over the course of 4 seconds.

r.name: Dragon's Rage

description.normalized: Launches a powerful roundhouse kick at an enemy champion, dealing 125 / 350 / 575 (+190% bonus AD + 12% / 15% / 18% of the target's maximum health) physical damage and knocking them back. Enemies the target collides with along the way are knocked Airborne for 1 second and take 100 / 300 / 500 (+200% bonus AD + 10% / 13% / 16% of the target's maximum Health). Damage dealt to monsters is caped at 800.
